verdict.rationale: cubic ships an official CLI (`cubic review`) that reviews uncommitted local changes and generates a fix prompt for a coding agent, which could plausibly be called from scripts. Its GitHub PR reviews also run automatically, but the evidence never documents headless or non-interactive CLI operation. missing for 10: documented non-interactive/headless mode, machine-readable output (e.g. JSON) or exit codes for scripting, CI/script usage examples, independent hands-on corroboration.
